description: Fix with AI: one open bug report from builder_bugs becomes a change request in the app's chat (like request_builder_change), linked to the report. Without request the prompt of builder_bugs (report) is sent; show it to the person first, they may change it (3 to 4000 characters). Costs builder credits like any change (editSmall to editLarge in builder_status prices, given back by the same rules). When a build of the new version or a later one is added, the report gets "Fixed in version X" and is resolved. Tell the person the cost, ask, and pass confirm: true. Follow it with builder_changes and builder_bugs. One AI step per app at a time. Developer role. Pro and Team. On Free (design only) the call answers 403 code BUILDER_DESIGN_ONLY: tell the person building the app's code is on Pro and Team.

request.description: The change request to send (optional, default the prompt of builder_bugs)

name: builder_fix_bug
title: Fix a builder app bug report with AI
